changes: GET /api/v1/org/settings — removed the required property `results/dataAppAutomaticThumbnailsEnabled` from the response with the `200` status
PATCH /api/v1/org/settings — removed the required property `results/dataAppAutomaticThumbnailsEnabled` from the response with the `200` status

declaredAdvisories.reason: GET and PATCH /api/v1/org/settings no longer return dataAppAutomaticThumbnailsEnabled, and PATCH ignores it if sent, because automatic data app thumbnails are removed. The field only controlled a capture gated by a feature flag that was off by default, and only the data apps settings page read or wrote it. During a rolling update an old settings tab reads the missing field as on and its toggle has no effect until refresh; nothing else on the page changes.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The data apps General settings page in the Lightdash web app is the only client that reads or writes dataAppAutomaticThumbnailsEnabled; it showed the control only behind the enable-data-app-automatic-thumbnails flag. Every other field of these operations is unchanged.
